name: Ningbo Sunrise Elc Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Ningbo Sunrise Elc Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the manufactures and sale of precision components. The company offers automotive components, such as battery insert molding parts, electrical control insert molding parts, connectors, connector parts, copper busbars, and press-fit pins for new energy vehicles; electronic components, such as motor and connector parts, and shield plates. It also provides smart devices, including smart TV parts, set-top boxes, gateways, heatsinks and shielding products, RF tuners, intelligent monitoring products, intelligent meters, and other intelligent terminals.
